title: Approve a composition
question: Galley Proof is locked. Which first-viewport composition should we build?

options.label: Two-column proof
options.thesis: The sheet is the page: offer on the left, both layers on the right, install as the lockup bar.
options.viewport: Header docket; 58/42 split; Mechanical PASS over Semantic kill; full-width npx bar; pipeline tabs at the fold.
options.risk: Reads as a docs homepage if the install bar is treated as a footer instead of the press.

options.label: Chase lockup
options.thesis: Everything lives inside one forme; the press bar cannot drop until both galleys are locked.
options.viewport: Inset chase, header on the rail, monumental flow, two equal galleys, press-bar command, pipeline cells outside.
options.risk: The frame becomes decoration if the two galleys shrink into cards.

options.label: Pass sheet
options.thesis: Two overlapping stamps are the mechanism; TO PRESS is the only next action.
options.viewport: Gutter stages 00–05, MECHANICAL over SEMANTIC, headline under the stamps, TO PRESS + npx at the lower right.
options.risk: Stamp theater can hide the install command; kill-at-ADR in the gutter must stay a demonstration, not a claim.
